description: Whole-genome Stockholm per serotype: structure-aware, indel-complete 5'NCR + 3'NCR (MAFFT X-INS-i seed -> RNAalifold consensus -> hand-RF Stockholm -> cmbuild --hand -> cmalign, full any-overlap population) stitched to the existing codon-aware CDS block from PV{st}_refframe_alignment.fasta.gz (unchanged, reused as-is). See docs/decision-log.md for the full narrative, the empirically-confirmed cmbuild --hand RF-line convention, and validation detail.
population: accessions with a valid serotype_assigned in the BS0a archive (status=='aligned', serotype_assignable=='TRUE') -- EXACTLY matches build_reference_msa.py's (BS0b's) own scope for the existing CDS ref-frame FASTA; smaller than the raw poliovirus-partition-per-serotype count (curated serotype_sequence) because ~1,326 partition records have no sequence-based serotype_assigned at all (too divergent/fragmentary for BS0a's capsid-based typing) and are already absent from the existing CDS file today.
hand_rf_convention: cmbuild --hand reads a GAP CHARACTER in the input #=GC RF line as an INSERT column and any non-gap character as a MATCH/consensus column -- confirmed empirically this session (NOT an upper/lowercase convention, which is unrelated display-side behavior of cmbuild's own auto-inferred RF line).
validation: Sabin reference row recovered exactly (100% match, T/U notation aside) at RF match columns across the FULL stitched genome width for all 3 serotypes -- the definitive end-to-end correctness check.
gap_semantics_caveat: '-' represents BOTH a genuine deletion at a covered position AND 'this record's block was entirely absent' (zero NCR overlap) -- not distinguished by a separate character. A missing block is always a full contiguous span of '-' across the whole block width, distinct in practice from scattered genuine deletions, but not flagged by dedicated metadata.
out_of_scope: LocARNA cross-check (declared out of scope, Mike's decision, 2026-07-23, not deferred); full-scale Infernal homology scan and ensemble/basin test (undecided); oriR 3'NCR tertiary 'kissing' interaction (not captured -- SS_cons reflects secondary structure only).
